household_message.text: Charge the car full, and make it nice and warm in the morning, 22-23 from 6 to 8.

message_to_household: The car cannot charge full by 07:30 tomorrow because the charger would need to run at 11.4 kW for 3 hours, but your setup only allows 3.7 kW. The gateway will charge the usual 80 % by 07:30 tomorrow.

questions.text: Should the car charge full (40 kWh) by 07:30 tomorrow, or keep the usual 80 %?
